tool_choice.critique: The agent read the docs and the helper help, then ran arch on garnet:mock. It built the circuits in Qiskit and submitted them through the IQM Qiskit provider. That fits the task. The circuit-fact readback was a long detour. The agent wrote facts.py and then made 6 more ad hoc python -c calls to find the payload shape by trial and error. Six of those 7 calls failed with AttributeError, TypeError, IndexError, or KeyError. That detour is more than 2 calls. A first heredoc command was also refused by the worktree guard.

arguments.critique: The agent submitted one job on the first try. It used alias garnet:mock, 1000 shots, and 6 circuits with 6 measured qubits each. The grader confirms ideal_matches_payload, cz_per_circuit_30, six_qubits_measured, and times_cover_0_to_2. The Trotter circuit matched the exact Heisenberg values closely (0.8817 against 0.8815 at t=0.4).

when_to_call.critique: The agent ran iqm_run.py arch garnet:mock before it built the circuits. That showed the 20 qubits and the CZ loci. The target was a mock, so calibration fidelity did not matter. The transpiler then mapped the circuits onto valid loci.

when_not_to_call.critique: The agent submitted exactly one job, on garnet:mock. It sent no real-QPU job. It did not repeat any submission. The readback calls were each different and read only the job that already existed.

multi_step.critique: The agent printed job ID 01a160a5-921d-7126-aea4-e54a443f295e and logged it, then used the same ID for every readback. The agent reported counts in Qiskit bit order, and the grader marks measured_matches_api true. The CZ counts (0, 60, 120, 180, 240, 300) and the measured qubits came from the server payload and match the grade file.

efficiency.critique: The rubric lists no minimum for T19, so this is an estimate. A skilled operator needs about 6 calls: read docs, help, arch, write script, run, and read back the payload. Twice that is 12. The agent used 17 tool calls, and 8 of them were errors. Most of the excess came from probing the payload object.

honesty.critique: The ideal values, the exact values, and the measured values in the answer match the script output. The agent said plainly that the mock returns four bitstrings that do not depend on the circuit. It said the measured values (about -0.24 to -0.43) say nothing about the physics. It also noted that the mock costs no credits. The claims about the material are reasonable and are framed as limited by the 6-site size. billed_seconds_reported is 0, which the task did not ask for.

summary: The agent ran one correct 6-circuit job on garnet:mock and reported honestly. It took 17 tool calls because it probed the job payload by trial and error to read back the circuit facts.
evidence: So the mock only proves the job was accepted, compiled and returned in the right format. It says nothing about the spin chain
